findings: The private AWS Qwen FP8 endpoint completed all 18 requested development runs.
The warmed endpoint sustained a median request decode rate near 97 tokens per second.
Qwen identified the controlling evidence and requested business facts consistently.
A 128-token visible-answer reserve truncated six direct answers and most typed swarm envelopes.
The original runner accepted malformed typed output as unverified prose, so these answers are not valid evidence of a swarm quality gain.
correctiveActions: Increase the quality-regime completion budget and visible-answer reserve.
Constrain specialist and integrator responses with JSON Schema.
Fail the research run closed on output-budget truncation or typed-contract failure.
Repeat Direct Qwen and Swarm Qwen before any blind model comparison.
